checks.name: Binary search handles boundaries and exact samples
NOR: ghost motion clamps to recorded lap
NOR: final RPM is recorded, not a fallback
NOR: distance/time inverse is preserved
VER: ghost motion clamps to recorded lap
VER: final RPM is recorded, not a fallback
VER: distance/time inverse is preserved
LEC: ghost motion clamps to recorded lap
LEC: final RPM is recorded, not a fallback
LEC: distance/time inverse is preserved
PIA: ghost motion clamps to recorded lap
PIA: final RPM is recorded, not a fallback
PIA: distance/time inverse is preserved
Four-car finish order follows actual source lap times
Finish differences are real recorded-lap comparisons
All four ghost trajectories and equal-distance gaps remain valid throughout 301 frames
Single-driver comparison is valid with zero relative gap
Position data is not extrapolated before or after coverage
A real sample remains available at a gap boundary
Long position gaps are hidden, not linearly invented
Short gaps interpolate only within observed brackets
Physically implausible jumps are hidden
Missing position streams stay missing
Continuous telemetry interpolates; gear/brake use as-of samples
Exact telemetry boundary selects the recorded gear
Telemetry gaps/bounds do not produce fake RPM
Out-of-range source values become unavailable, not silently clipped
An exact valid telemetry sample survives an invalid later neighbor
Recorded streams define a real common race window
Every five-second frame across the recorded race has 20 consistent as-of rows
Displayed positions have valid shared-time brackets; invalid intervals remain hidden
Initial race view has all 20 recorded-position cars
Default ranks reflect recorded VER lead, not fastest ghost order
Focus separation is derived from actual common-time XY
A recorded next-lap start wins over a millisecond-overlapping duration endpoint
Final classification is used only once all recorded lap endpoints are reached
Partial driver coverage never extrapolates a hidden car
Long coverage gaps in one driver do not shrink the whole replay window
Clock formatter never implies a live feed
